notes.title: Vaporspace Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
Clicks:  Faster clicking should now be read correctly and register more clicks towards click related achievements. (Left Clicks)  Also keyboard keys now count toward clicks but are limited to 1 per second.  (Holding down keys works in this case as well.)

New Ship 29: Antique!   Art by Flatlander  @ Opengameart

New Zone: Kowloon (Based on Kowloon Walled City.  More detail will be added later to this one)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34606880/90e6ed7f1160f9550457e07a080facdf521f8f73.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34606880/fbe6131bd5d08a6b53784c7fe79f3b4cc0e98bea.gif[/img]

Text for Random Ship Button

Portals no longer round down to the nearest 1000x stage.

New Ships should now also appear as potential base defenders.

Fixed an issue where Ship Exp/Levels were not being gained when 2nd set of ships were selected through the “Random Ship” option.

Right Clicking on the Currency button in Aesthetifacts now moves backward through the sets of upgrades.

^ Same for Followers AI in the ships menu, and LevelSkips/Max buttons in options.

Crimson Artifacts can now be reset and banked.  The higher the upgrade the better the conversion rate. Banking a level 10 Crimson Art to 0 only keeps 1 but banking a level 100 to 90 keeps full 10 into the bank.  The banked Crimson Artifacts ALSO increase the amount of blue coins gained.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34606880/10e38bdee3dec7a8c068ae97f8e1fe61241d9a36.png[/img]
Increased Level skip penalty of Crimson7 from 20 to 50

Increased Ammo/Shield penalty of Crimson11/12 from 2 to 40

Artifact 11/12 No longer grant billions of credits at high amounts but upgrade Blue9 has been increased from 1 billion per to 5 billion per upgrade to help compensate.

notes.title: Vaporspace Update 1.1.2 (Tiny update)
notes.content:
Time related achievements changed to play X hours “on one save.”

Fixed issue with spore shield not appearing

Blue 8:Writing Rainbow display amounts updated

notes.title: Vaporspace Update 1.1.1 (Small update)
notes.content:
Counter for boss hp should now always show integer values.

The deathly shroud that appears after stage 1m now ramps up over 100,000 stages above your Dark Artifact level instead of 10,000.

Fragment Upgrade 13 (Bear) has been reworked to be more consistent.  It used to scale with damage, but only increased the damage by billions after certain thresholds were met.

(OLD)Bear: Boss takes billions (rounded down only) of extra damage per hit on level 1,000,000+

(NEW)Bear:Adds 0.1% chance per hit that bosses takes 1b damage. (Requires 5,000 Fragment upgrades.)

Blue 7: Writing Rainbow buffed to 10b per click/tap instead of 1b.

Crimson Artifact timer max increases from 5 seconds per upgrade to 10 seconds per upgrade.

notes.title: Crimson Artifact Upgrades
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34606880/73ba2a6364eb3d8d8da4362d3d6541d7c5934a34.png[/img]

These “upgrades” go to a maximum of 100 and become available after reaching stage 1m.

They all increase the difficulty of gameplay in some way but also increase the chance for a blue coin drop from a boss after 1m by 10% per upgrade.

They will be based on a timer so you can buy a few at a time.  There is no way currently to remove or turn them off but I will probably add a way in a future patch.

Trackball Mouse: Increase minimum stage time by 10
Abandoned Mall: Faster max enemy movement speed
Cassettes: Increases max number of enemy shots per set.
Walkman: Increases fragment cost to open rifts by 1.
Rubiks Cube: Decrease player Regeneration by 0.66%
Fax Machine: Increase enemy spawn rate

notes.title: Vaporspace New Blue Coins Upgrades
notes.content:
Introducing new Blue Coin upgrades!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34606880/a839df0cef2cc32b6a813974fd89294de37fb985.png[/img]

Starting with the Cities patch Blue Coins now drop one per portal completed (stage 1000+) and from each boss defeated after stage 1m.  The upgrades go to a maximum of 100  and their starting cost is 1 coin to give more available upgrades for early-mid levels.

The first 6 upgrades are available to you as soon as you can complete portals while the bottom 7 are only unlocked after reaching stage 1m.

Glam Metal - Increase artifacts gained from each drop by 1 per
Arcade Machine - Decrease damage taken by 0.8% per
Floppy Disks - Increase pet coin drop rate in rifts
Converters - Increase shield regen chance .3% per
Laser Sabers - Increase ammo regen chance .3% per
Contraption Inspectors - Decrease cost of HP/ATK upgrades after 1,000,000 by 1b per (minimum cost 1b)

notes.title: Working on content for first update "Cities"
Vaporspace Release!
notes.content:
Hello, Vaporspace has been released!  Let me know what you think.   A couple have reported the cloud saving doesn't always default to the correct directory when starting a save file.  Cloud Saves should be put here:
 C:\Users\User\%appdata%\Roaming\vaporsave

I am going to be fixing existing issues before adding content.  I work alone on the game and also a different job 40-54 hours a week so be nice ;) <3
